rules.statement: A purchaser of premises is entitled to maintain an action under section 9 (2) of the Rent Restriction Act for the ejectment of a tenant and sub-tenant where the tenant had previously sub-let in contravention of section 9 (1).
rules.supporting_quote: Where any premises or any part thereof is sub-let in contravention of the provisions of Sub-section (1), the landlord shall, notwithstanding the provisions of Section 13, be entitled in an action instituted in a Court of competent jurisdiction to a decree for the ejectment from the premises of his tenant and of the person or each of the persons to whom the premises or any part thereof has been so sub-let.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 9 (2) of the Rent Restriction Act No. 29 of 1948
